description.en:
When his parents suddenly go on a trip overseas, Keita is left alone at home. His cousin Ryouko comes over to look after him, but she turns out to be a naughty older sister who loves cute boys!

“Kei-chan… do you want to do something like what's in that dirty book?”

A masterpiece from zunta-sensei for all older sister lovers!

Originally published in *comic anthurium* Vols. [003](https://comic.gotbb.jp/comics/magazine/comicanthurium/comic-a-003) & [005](https://comic.gotbb.jp/comics/magazine/comicanthurium/comic-a-005).

description.ja: 突然の親の海外旅行によって家に一人残された恵。そこに従姉の遼子姉ちゃんが世話しにやってきてくれたんだけど、お姉ちゃんは可愛い男の子が大好きないけないお姉さんだった！「恵ちゃん…あのHな本みたいな事してみたい？」zunta先生が全お姉ちゃん好きに贈る至極の一作！　※本作品は「comicアンスリウムvol.3」に収録されております。
